walkthroughs.body_html:
Paper 2: Externally Set Assignment — a core area of GCSE Art & Design.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Paper 2: Externally Set Assignment brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Paper 2: Externally Set Assignment.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which technique uses crossing lines for tone?

Cross-hatching
Smudging
Tracing
Lines
Dots
Circles
Squares

mcqs.q: What did Renaissance artists rediscover that medieval art lacked?
options: Painting on canvas.
The use of colour.
Linear perspective and naturalistic representation of the human body.
Just measurements.

mcqs.q: What is appropriation in postmodern art?
options: Painting in an old-fashioned style.
Painting on canvas.
Stealing artwork to sell.
Deliberately reusing existing images or styles, often to comment on originality.

mcqs.q: What can line in a composition imply, even without representing an object?
options: Just measurements.
Movement, direction, emotion, and visual rhythm.
Painting in an old-fashioned style.
Only the outline of an object.
